messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — customer reported intermittent 'stuttering' on SSE where the stream cuts at ~18s, client reconnects immediately, and they see a second completed generation (double charge). They attached a short client log and session id.

maria_cs: customer ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/2457 — session_id: session_7b9c2a — request_id: req_0a1b2c3d — happened around 2026-03-16T14:22:31Z

zoe_support: thx — can you paste the snippet of the client log they sent? also is the client using EventSource or a fetch stream?

maria_cs: here's the excerpt customer pasted:
```
[client] connection opened
[client] received chunk 1 (tokens 0-120)
[client] stream error: network error (ECONNRESET) at 00:18.2
[client] reconnecting immediately
[client] new request sent with same session token
[client] received full generation (duplicate)
```
They say they're using an EventSource polyfill in an older mobile webview and reconnect immediately on any error.

alex_eng_runtime: quick thoughts — two possibilities: (1) an upstream idle/keepalive timeout closes the connection which the client sees as an error, then the client retries causing a new generation; (2) our resume semantics may not have a strict checkpoint before completing the generation, so a resumed request can re-run final decode and produce duplicated tokens. need L7 logs + gateway/envoy idle_timeout values and the exact SSE framing we emit.

sam_sre: I'm pulling LB/envoy access logs now for the time window. If there's a pool with a 15s idle timeout that would align with ~18s if there was a small delay. will report back within 20m.

zoe_support: meanwhile, quick mitigation we can offer customer: (a) add an Idempotency-Key header per user-facing request (UUID), (b) increase client reconnect backoff to 300-800ms jittered, and (c) if possible consume resume_token and call with resume_token to avoid re-running. I'll send steps.

maria_cs: sent the workaround to customer and asked them to try idempotency-key + backoff. they said they can test in the next hour and will share results.

alex_eng_runtime: for server-side: I can add a quick check so that if a request arrives with the same Idempotency-Key within the same session window we return the previously produced result instead of re-running generation. also will look at making the resume checkpoint emit a short 'finalized' marker before the server closes connection so clients don't assume partial output requires re-run. ETA: EOD patch for idempotency short-circuit.

sam_sre: LB logs show several abrupt upstream FINs at 18.1s from the same edge cluster. env pool config shows upstream_idle_timeout = 15s on some older hosts (k8s nodepool-edge-2). I will open a configuration patch to raise to 60s for all edge pools and roll. scheduling change — low-risk config change.

deploy_bot: deploy queued by sam_sre for infra/edge-timeout-bump — build #8745 queued.

tara_finance: noted on billing — mark for provisional refund if duplicate generation confirmed. please include request_ids and timestamps in the refund ticket.

maria_cs: confirmed with customer they saw duplicate token usage at 14:22:49Z (roughly 18s after start). asked them for the full raw SSE transcript and UA string.

alex_eng_runtime: action items for eng-runtime: (1) implement idempotency-key short-circuit (PR ready, testing), (2) add stronger resume checkpoint marker in SSE payload so clients know what was committed. I'll own (1). assign to alex_eng_runtime.

sam_sre: action items for SRE: patch idle_timeout on affected edge pools and roll config. I'll coordinate and post rollout timeline.

zoe_support: I'll draft internal KB 'SSE microdisconnects — mitigation checklist' including: suggest Idempotency-Key, backoff guidance, resume_token handling, and when to request refunds.

maria_cs: customer will test workaround. asked for logs and will update this thread in ~2 hours.

alex_eng_runtime: if customer repros, please attach the raw SSE transcript (including event: messages and the resume_token field) — that lets us verify whether the resume path triggered or a fresh generation started.

tara_finance: once we have two matching request_ids/timestamps flagged as duplicates I'll process a provisional refund.

zoe_support: adding note — escalate to incident if multiple customers affected or spike in duplicate billing reported.

maria_cs: thanks all — will follow up. :thumbsup:
